description: Set the state of one Markdown checkbox identified by path + line (from list_tasks), rewriting exactly one character — the rest of the file, frontmatter included, stays byte-identical. Pass expectText to guard against the line having changed, and prevHash for full compare-and-swap. Setting the current state again is a success no-op.

expectText.description: Optional guard: the task text list_tasks returned. Fails with task_text_mismatch if the line’s text changed since.

line.description: 1-based line number of the task, as returned by list_tasks.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

state.description: New marker character: "x" (done), " " (open), or a custom marker like "/".

name: update_task
